newsitem.title: USA: Brunswick CEO backs analysts' 97 EPS of $2.15.
newsitem.headline: Brunswick CEO backs analysts' 97 EPS of $2.15.

text.p: The Chief Executive Officer of Brunswick Corp said he backs Wall Street analysts' consensus earnings per share estimates of $2.15 for 1997.
"We think that's not an unreasonable number," the Chief Executive Peter Larson, said in an interview after he spoke to an analysts meeting at the annual Super Show Trade exhibit.
During his presentation, an analyst asked the Chief Executive Officer of the manufacturer of sporting goods equipment whether or not the company would consider a stock buy-back this year.
"The odds of us doing that are not high," he said, saying that the company would prefer to make acquisitions with any spare cash.
"This is an industry that is consolidating," he said.
